text: 香港证监会今天发出经修订的通函，将规定其容量高度受市况变化影响的杠杆及反向产品，须采用灵活杠杆结构。在此结构下，杠杆倍数可在现有上限（即杠杆产品为2倍，反向产品为-2倍）内每日调整。因此，产品提供者在必要时可下调该等产品的目标杠杆倍数，从而于高交易量期间有更大空间管理产品。该等产品于下一交易日的杠杆倍数将于每日收市后披露。杠杆倍数每日的潜在调整，亦有助加深投资者对杠杆及反向产品属单日产品的认识，提醒投资者该等产品并不适合持有超过一日。（香港证监会网站）
text_en: Today, the Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission issued a revised circular requiring leveraged and inverse products, whose capacity is highly susceptible to market condition changes, to adopt a flexible leverage structure. Under this structure, the leverage ratio can be adjusted daily within the existing caps (i.e., 2x for leveraged products and -2x for inverse products). Therefore, product providers can lower the target leverage ratio of these products when necessary, allowing greater room to manage the product during high-volume trading periods. The leverage ratio for the next trading day will be disclosed after each day's close. The potential daily adjustment of the leverage ratio also helps deepen investor understanding that leveraged and inverse products are single-day products, reminding investors that these products are not suitable for holding beyond one day. (SFC website)
